nvitk.gui.io.napari_io¶

Load images into Napari via nvitk.io (NIfTI, DICOM, TIFF, MHA, ND2, …).

img’s axis labels if they match ndim, else the default NIfTI axis order for ndim.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._prepare_layer_tuple(img: nvitk.types.Image, path: pathlib.Path) → LayerData¶

Build a napari-plugin-style (data, layer_kwargs, layer_type) tuple for img, reorienting the array for display and computing scale/affine, axis labels, and nvitk metadata from path.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._read_layer_data(path: str) → list[LayerData] | None¶

Read one path into Napari layer tuples.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io.read_paths(path: str | list[str]) → ReaderFunc | list[LayerData] | None¶

Napari npe2 reader command.

When called with a single path string (npe2 command exec), returns a reader function. When that function is invoked, returns layer data tuples.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._add_image_to_viewer(viewer: Any, img: nvitk.types.Image, path: pathlib.Path) → Any¶

Add img to viewer as an Image layer using _prepare_layer_tuple()’s display kwargs, then apply nvitk’s viewer/dims configuration for the new layer.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io.open_paths_with_nvitk(viewer: Any, paths: str | pathlib.Path | Sequence[str | pathlib.Path], *, stack=False, force_type: str | None = None) → list[Any]¶

Open one or more paths with nvitk.io and add Napari layers.

force_type is forwarded to imread() (e.g. "nifti" when opening a directory that must not be treated as DICOM).

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._notify_error(message: str) → None¶

Show message via Napari’s error notification, falling back to printing it if Napari’s UI isn’t available.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._is_nvitk_layer(layer: Any) → bool¶

True if layer was loaded through nvitk’s reader (carries an nvitk_metadata entry).

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._layer_from_list_event(event: Any) → Any | None¶

Layer instance from Napari inserted / legacy added events.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._on_nvitk_layer_inserted(viewer: Any, event: Any) → None¶

Configure viewer dims/orientation for a newly inserted layer: repairs the time-dim range for overlays and 4D+ layers, and applies nvitk’s display setup for 4D+ or nvitk-sourced layers.

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io._on_active_layer_sync_dims(viewer: Any, _event: Any) → None¶

Re-apply 4D dims when selecting a 4D layer (3D oblique affines can pollute viewer.dims).

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io.install_nvitk_layer_hooks(viewer: Any) → None¶

Configure dims when layers are added by the nvitk-io reader (not only Qt open).

nvitk.gui.io.napari_io.install_nvitk_io(viewer: Any) → None¶

Hook Qt open/drop paths to nvitk.io.

Napari’s Viewer model is Pydantic and does not allow patching open; we wrap QtViewer._qt_open instead.
